summary: Keep TileLang, TVM and FlashInfer compile caches on the persistent /cache volume
details: These caches defaulted to the home directory inside the container, so a recreated container compiled them again; DeepSeek V4 lost minutes of TileLang compilation per start.
The launcher now places them under /cache/jit/<runtime>/<profile>/ next to the B12X, Triton and vLLM caches; explicit values still take precedence.
